hero.name: Kevin Patterson
hero.fullStackDeveloper: Cybersecurity Engineer & Full Stack Web Developer
hero.content: I'm a passionate Cybersecurity Engineer and Web Developer, specialized in creating robust, scalable, and secure web applications. I study Cybersecurity Engineering at the University of Informatics Sciences (UCI) in Havana and have solid hands-on experience with modern technologies such as React, Next.js, Node.js, Django, PostgreSQL, and MySQL, combined with an advanced focus on offensive and defensive security. I have participated in Capture the Flag competitions, vulnerability analysis projects, E2E test automation, and perimeter protection using tools like Nmap, Wireshark, Burp Suite, Nessus, Metasploit, Shodan, and OpenVAS, among others. I also have experience in Cyber Intelligence and OSINT, applying methodologies for early detection of data leaks, exposure of critical services, and corporate digital footprint analysis, supported by tools such as Maltego, SpiderFoot, theHarvester, Shodan, and Google Dorks.

about.text: Since I was very young, technology and its endless possibilities have fascinated me. As a committed full stack developer, I combine creativity with technical expertise to design and develop high-performance, user-friendly web applications, always adding a focus on security. With 3 years of professional experience, I have honed my skills with modern tools and frameworks, integrating security into every stage of development — from system architecture to deployment and monitoring. My goal is to transform innovative ideas into secure digital solutions that drive business growth and deliver exceptional user experiences without compromising data integrity or privacy.

experiences.description: At the University of Informatics Sciences (UCI), I participated in the design and implementation of an information system for the comprehensive management of the university's extension events. This project aimed to optimize the registration, control, and monitoring of cultural, sports, and academic activities, facilitating traceability and real-time information analysis. I applied the agile SCRUM methodology with daily meetings with the client to ensure continuous communication, iterative delivery of features, and an efficient, stable, and well-aligned final product.

At UCI, I developed scalable web applications using Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Nest.js, and React.js, also collaborated closely with multidisciplinary teams, valuing clear communication and trust while we built solutions that truly enhanced user experience, security, and system performance.
At UCI, I was responsible for training an AI model for the automated detection of phishing emails.
At CITMATEL, I focused on designing and developing an Automated Web Hosting Management System. This experience deepened my understanding of process automation and its importance.

At UCI, I developed a Food Recipe Management web application. I collaborated closely with a professional team, valuing clear communication and trust throughout the project, always prioritizing user experience and security above all.

During my internship at CACSA (Sept 2024 - Feb 2025), I was responsible for developing a web platform for cybersecurity services (CAS) and implementing an automated perimeter protection service based on Cloudflare, using the agile SCRUM methodology with daily client meetings. Simultaneously, as a thesis project at UCI (Nov 2025 - Feb 2026), I designed and implemented an automated perimeter protection service based on Cloudflare, integrating security controls, provisioning automation, and best practices to improve the resilience and availability of web platforms by mitigating DDoS attacks, filtering malicious traffic, and ensuring secure access through WAF policies and rate limiting. Both projects share the same perimeter security initiative. I also conducted passive and active vulnerability analysis on corporate websites, monitored the corporate network, applied data correlation techniques from open sources for digital forensic analysis, and performed audits of company premises.

At ECNA, I was in charge of analyzing corporate Squid proxy web traces, evaluating them and collecting digital forensic evidence following the proper incident management cycle. I also conducted passive and active vulnerability analysis on corporate web pages, monitored the corporate network, applied data correlation techniques from open sources for digital forensic analysis, and performed audits of company premises.
During my internship at ECNA, I was responsible for performing automated E2E testing on the institution's web platforms, ensuring their functionality, availability, and integrity.

As a freelance developer, I defined the project structure, PostgreSQL schema with RLS, critical database functions, and the PWA frontend platform oriented to operations in environments with unstable connectivity for a multi-tenant SaaS ERP for Cuban SMEs, with offline-first support, multi-currency (CUP/MLC/USD), and generation of exportable tax reports compliant with ONAT and the Ministry of Finance and Prices.

projects.title: Cocina con Nosotros - Food Recipe Management System
projects.description: Full-stack web system for cooking recipe management with authentication, moderated publishing, and interactive community. Features: user registration and login with Google OAuth support (django-allauth), anti-brute-force blocking system (django-axes) after failed attempts, recipe publishing with images (Pillow), categorization (Breakfasts, Meals, Desserts, Beverages), moderation system with recipe approval, user comments and ratings, advanced search and sorting by date/category, change auditing (django-auditlog), QR code generation (qrcode). Security: CSRF protection, strict password validation, access control with @login_required, restricted access to private files, compliance with Regulation 128/2019 MINCOM.

projects.title: CubanSaas - Cybersecurity Thesis Project
projects.description: Automated perimeter protection service based on Cloudflare, developed as an academic thesis project. Implementation of a CSaaS (Cloudflare as a Service) model compatible with free plan. Frontend in React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS, serverless backend in Python with Vercel Functions. Features: automatic provisioning in under 2 seconds, unique subdomain generation, DNS A proxied, mapping in Workers KV, application of 8 automatic protections (SSL/TLS Strict, Force HTTPS, WAF, Bot Fight Mode, Browser Integrity Check, Security Level High, Rate Limiting, custom Firewall Rules). Security proxy at edge with Cloudflare Worker filtering malicious patterns (XSS, SQLi, LFI, path traversal), blocking unsafe methods (TRACE, TRACK), normalizing inputs and forwarding to real origin. Admin panel, DNS delegation checker, real-time logs, Turnstile anti-bot. Database-less architecture, Workers KV persistence, 13 automated tests passed, extensive documentation with 38+ files.

projects.title: Clavisoft - Software Services Platform
projects.description: Modern corporate web platform for a software development company specializing in digital solutions. Built with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS using a scalable, professional feature-based architecture. Includes a complete admin panel with project, service, product, and message management, real-time notifications, and activity logs. Robust security: JWT authentication with Jose, password hashing with Argon2/bcryptjs, CSP headers, HSTS, signed URLs. Performance optimizations: client-side image compression with browser-image-compression, AVIF/WebP formats, production build optimization. Full SEO: dynamic metadata, Google Analytics integration, sitemap, Open Graph, robots.txt. Form system with Zod validation, Nodemailer email delivery, rate limiting. Comprehensive testing: Vitest for unit tests, Playwright for E2E. 150+ dependencies, 9 main features, 20+ shared components, feature flags for functionality control.

projects.title: Patitas — Pet Reunion Platform
projects.description: Community platform to reunite lost pets, report found animals, and promote responsible adoptions. Centralizes structured, searchable, and geolocalized information with guaranteed privacy. Includes AI system for form autocompletion, OCR, hybrid matching, and duplicate detection. PWA with real-time notifications, full-text search, interactive Leaflet map, social comment system, sighting timeline, automatic moderation, and complete audit trail. Anime Edition Design System with 11 animation types, perimeter security with RLS across all tables, multi-level rate limiting, and AI assistant visibility via llms.txt and JSON-LD.

projects.title: CubaPress - News Aggregator
projects.description: Intelligent news aggregator with focus on Cuban and international media. Implements a robust fallback system across multiple APIs (NewsData.io, TheNewsAPI, NewsAPI) and RSS feeds, ensuring continuous availability. Features advanced search, category filtering, dual visualization modes (grid/list), infinite scroll, custom Word bulletin export, intelligent web scraping for complete content, and search history. Professional dark editorial newsroom theme with full-text search and automatic prioritization of Cuban sources. This project was developed as part of a React.js course and enhanced for daily use.

projects.title: Encant Shop - Accessories Catalog
projects.description: Comprehensive web catalog platform for accessories and personalized gifts with a complete admin panel. Modern frontend in React + TypeScript + TailwindCSS and serverless Python APIs. Features product and category management, image uploads to Supabase Storage, persistent shopping cart in localStorage, real-time search, WhatsApp ordering, visitor analytics dashboard, light/dark theme, secure authentication with PBKDF2-SHA512, 24-hour httpOnly sessions, login rate limiting, and multi-store support. Architecture includes Row Level Security on Supabase, 30-second caching, image validation (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 3MB), and daily cron to keep the database active.

projects.title: Anniversary Gift — Romantic Personalized Page
projects.description: Interactive and emotional page designed as an anniversary gift. Features a real-time counter for time spent together, horizontal-scrolling photo gallery, interactive timeline of special moments, personalized letter, background music, delicate animations, and a playful surprise section. Includes integrated QR code for quick access and a separate page to generate, customize, and download it. Warm design with romantic color palette (wine, rose, and cream tones) and elegant Cormorant Garamond typography.

projects.title: CuadreCaja - Offline Cash Register System
projects.description: PWA for managing daily cash register reconciliation in Cuban small and medium businesses. Works completely offline with local storage, includes 6-step wizard, OCR with Gemini to scan previous reconciliations, and CSV/PDF export.

projects.title: Serbero Ink - Tattoo Studio Website
projects.description: Tattoo studio website with integrated custom CMS. Operates without traditional database, content lives in versioned files on GitHub. Includes automatic ES/EN translation, password-protected admin panel, and automatic content refresh.

projects.title: Sinergia Cuba - Multi-tenant SaaS ERP for Cuban SMEs
projects.description: Sinergia Cuba is a SaaS ERP designed for Cuban SMEs that combines daily operations (inventory, material requests, invoicing) with tax compliance and financial analysis. The platform is multi-tenant (one company = one isolated space), offline-first (PWA + intelligent synchronization), and prepared to generate reports and exports compatible with the requirements of ONAT and the Ministry of Finance and Prices.

projects.title: WebSec Framework - Framework for automated web security audits
projects.description: Modular framework executable natively (Currently in development) for web application security audits. Automates the entire workflow: intelligent crawling (incl. JS), technology fingerprinting, module-based scanning (XSS, SQLi, LFI, CSRF, CORS, XXE, SSRF, Command Injection, Auth), automatic false positive validation, and professional HTML/PDF report generation with contextual risk scoring, which also includes integration with some external tools.

projects.title: Parsel & Parcel House — Magical Artifacts Shop
projects.description: Gothic-mystical themed e-commerce with a catalog of enchanted parcels, rare artifacts, and magical supplies. Organized by Houses with a shopping cart and review system.

projects.title: Gaby Shop - Online Product Store
projects.description: Online store with a varied product catalog. Modern interface with shopping cart and integrated order system.

projects.title: Gaby's Prints - Custom Printing Shop
projects.description: E-commerce specialized in custom prints and personalized products. Interactive catalog with customization options.

projects.title: Mipyme Store - Home Appliances Digital Shop
projects.description: MVP of a complete digital store for a Cuban small business specializing in home appliances. Features a product catalog with category filters, real-time search, interactive 3D card effects on product cards, and direct WhatsApp redirection for order management. Includes an admin panel for complete product, category, and image management through CRUD operations with Supabase.

projects.title: Termal Print Pro (MVP) - SaaS Platform for Thermal Labels in Food and Retail
projects.description: Minimum Viable Product of a SaaS platform for thermal labeling in Food and Retail using React.js, TailwindCSS, and Next.js.

projects.title: Incident Management System
projects.description: Incident tracking dashboard with a synthwave aesthetic. Real-time incident panel with P1–P4 priority levels. Filters by status, assignee, and time range. On-call team status with live availability.

projects.title: CRM Pro - Enterprise Client Management System
projects.description: Frontend of an enterprise CRM platform with full client management, sales pipeline, activity tracking, real-time reports, and metrics. Modern design oriented to commercial teams.

projects.title: Marketplace
projects.description: Frontend of a Cuban e-commerce platform with multi-currency catalog (CUP, USD, MLC), real-time exchange rates via El Toque, shopping cart, and secure payments through EnZona.

projects.title: Las Delicias — Digital Menu
projects.description: Frontend of a Cuban cuisine restaurant website with interactive menu, reservation system, online ordering, and gallery. Warm design with Caribbean identity and online booking section.

projects.title: RopaStore — Fashion E-commerce
projects.description: Frontend of an e-commerce store with detailed product pages and image gallery. Shopping cart with direct WhatsApp ordering. Multi-currency support: USD, CUP, and MLC.

projects.title: La Cabina — Recording Studio Marketplace in Cuba
projects.description: Frontend of an Airbnb-style platform connecting recording studios in Cuba with musicians and artists. Directory, studio profiles, booking system, and reviews.

projects.title: ERP SaaS — Business Management System for SMEs
projects.description: MVP of a SaaS ERP for Cuban micro, small, and medium-sized businesses. Operations, resource, and business process management in a single platform. Scalable multi-tenant architecture and full admin dashboard.

projects.title: SubFinder - Multi-Source Subtitle Search Engine
projects.description: MVP of a modern web application for searching and downloading subtitles in multiple languages. Integrates various sources (OpenSubtitles, Subdl, Subdivx) in an elegant interface with favorites system, search history, and secure authentication via Supabase.

projects.title: Weather App
projects.description: React web application that allows users to check the current weather in any city in the world.

projects.title: Car Insurance Quoter
projects.description: Web app to quote car insurance using React.js, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS.

projects.title: Client Management CRM
projects.description: Minimalist web app designed to easily and effectively manage client information.

projects.title: Cryptocurrency Quoter
projects.description: Web application that allows users to quote the value of different cryptocurrencies in real time.

projects.title: Veterinary Patient Management
projects.description: Frontend app built with React and Vite to efficiently and practically manage veterinary patients.

projects.title: Budget Control
projects.description: Interactive frontend app designed in React with Vite and LocalStorage to help efficiently manage your budget.
